title: Debug and fix slider progress persistence system

requirements.summary: Fix the updateMilestoneProgressMutation in useTasks.ts to correctly pass milestoneId and progress percentage to the backend actor's updateMilestoneProgress method
acceptanceCriteria: The mutation receives milestoneId and progress as parameters
The mutation calls actor.updateMilestoneProgress with correct argument format
Console logs show the mutation is triggered when slider moves
The mutation handles the backend response correctly
Error responses are caught and logged with full details

file_operations.description: Add comprehensive console logging to updateMilestoneProgressMutation to log the received milestoneId and progress parameters at the start of the mutation. Verify the mutation calls actor.updateMilestoneProgress with the correct argument types (bigint for milestoneId, bigint for progress). Add console logging for the backend response in the onSuccess callback. Enhance error handling in the onError callback to log the full error object, error message, and error stack trace to help identify why the update fails.

requirements.summary: Debug the slider onChange handler in MilestoneSection.tsx to ensure it correctly triggers the updateMilestoneProgressMutation with the milestone ID and new progress value
acceptanceCriteria: The slider component has a functional onChange or onValueChange handler
The handler extracts the new progress value from the slider event
The handler calls updateMilestoneProgressMutation.mutate with milestoneId and progress
Console logs confirm the handler fires when the slider is moved
The slider is not disabled or blocked by loading states

file_operations.description: Add console logging at the start of the slider's onChange or onValueChange handler to log the milestone ID and the new progress value being extracted from the slider event. Verify the handler correctly calls updateMilestoneProgressMutation.mutate with the milestone ID (converted to bigint if necessary) and the progress value (converted to bigint). Check that the slider is not disabled during loading states and that the handler fires immediately when the slider moves. Add a console log confirming the mutation.mutate call with the exact parameters being passed.

requirements.summary: Add comprehensive console logging throughout the slider interaction flow from slider onChange through mutation call, response, cache invalidation, to UI refresh
acceptanceCriteria: Console log when slider onChange handler is triggered with milestone ID and new value
Console log when updateMilestoneProgressMutation.mutate is called with parameters
Console log when mutation succeeds or fails with response data
Console log when React Query invalidates the milestones cache
Console log when getAllMilestones query refetches data

file_operations.description: Add console logging at the top of the slider onChange handler with a clear label like 'SLIDER CHANGED:' followed by the milestone ID and new progress value. Add another console log immediately before calling updateMilestoneProgressMutation.mutate with a label like 'CALLING MUTATION:' and the parameters being passed. This establishes the start of the debugging chain.

Add console logging at the start of updateMilestoneProgressMutation with label 'MUTATION STARTED:' and the received parameters. In the onSuccess callback, add console logging with label 'MUTATION SUCCESS:' and the response data. In the onError callback, add console logging with label 'MUTATION ERROR:' and the full error object. Before calling queryClient.invalidateQueries, add console logging with label 'INVALIDATING CACHE:' and the query keys being invalidated. After invalidation, add console logging with label 'CACHE INVALIDATED' to confirm completion.

requirements.summary: Ensure React Query cache invalidation triggers correctly after updateMilestoneProgress mutation success, forcing a fresh fetch of milestone data that includes the updated progress percentage
acceptanceCriteria: The onSuccess callback in updateMilestoneProgressMutation calls queryClient.invalidateQueries for milestones
The invalidation targets the correct query key used by getAllMilestones
The UI re-renders with fresh data after invalidation completes
The slider displays the persisted progress value from the backend, not just local state

file_operations.description: In the updateMilestoneProgressMutation's onSuccess callback, verify that queryClient.invalidateQueries is called with the exact query key used by the getAllMilestones query (check that the key matches, likely ['milestones']). Add console logging before and after the invalidation call to confirm it executes. Ensure the invalidation is awaited or chained properly so the UI refetch completes before the success toast appears. Verify no local state is interfering with displaying the persisted backend value.

requirements.summary: Fix error handling in the slider mutation flow to display clear, user-friendly error messages in Spanish when updateMilestoneProgress fails, including specific details about what went wrong
acceptanceCriteria: The onError callback in updateMilestoneProgressMutation catches all error types
Error messages distinguish between network failures, backend errors, and validation errors
Toast notifications display specific error details in Spanish
The slider reverts to its previous position if the update fails
Console logs include full error stack traces for debugging

file_operations.description: Enhance the onError callback in updateMilestoneProgressMutation to detect error types (network errors, backend errors, validation errors) and construct specific Spanish error messages. Log the full error object including stack trace to the console for debugging. Display a toast notification with a clear Spanish error message that includes the error type and any available error details. If possible, include the milestone ID in the error message to help with debugging.

Store the previous slider value in local state before calling the mutation. If the mutation fails (detected via mutation.isError or a rejected promise), revert the slider to the previous value using a useEffect or direct state update. Add console logging when reverting the slider with label 'REVERTING SLIDER:' and the previous value. This ensures the UI reflects the actual persisted state if the update fails.

requirements.summary: Test the complete end-to-end slider flow manually and ensure all console logs fire in sequence, backend confirms updates, and the persisted value displays correctly after page refresh
acceptanceCriteria: Moving the slider triggers all expected console logs in sequence
The backend confirms receiving and processing the update request
The milestone progress value persists after page refresh
The slider position reflects the value stored in the backend
No errors appear in console or toast notifications during normal operation
The flow completes within 2 seconds under normal network conditions

file_operations.description: Add a final verification console log when the component re-renders after a successful mutation with label 'COMPONENT RE-RENDERED:' showing the milestone ID and the new progress value from the refetched data. This confirms the entire cycle completed successfully. Ensure the slider value is bound to the milestone.progress value from the backend query, not from local component state, so it always reflects the persisted backend value.

Add a console log in the getAllMilestones query when it successfully fetches data with label 'MILESTONES FETCHED:' and the count of milestones returned. This helps verify that the refetch after invalidation is completing successfully and returning updated data. Add timing logs to measure how long the mutation and refetch cycle takes.
